topic: Claude Code cloud scheduled tasks: a helper that works even when your computer is off
post:
What if Claude did a task for you every morning, even with your laptop closed? 🌙
That's what Claude Code's cloud scheduled tasks do.

A scheduled task is a saved prompt that runs on a timetable you pick. "Cloud" means it runs on Anthropic's computers, not yours. ☁️

Fun fact: the drafts for this very series are prepared by one. ✅

How to start 👇
1️⃣ Go to claude.ai/code/routines (or type /schedule in Claude Code)
2️⃣ Write what you want done, in plain English
3️⃣ Pick when it runs, like every weekday at 7 AM

The golden rule from the Claude Code docs:
The task runs on its own, so it can't ask you questions. Say exactly what "done" looks like and what to do with the result. 🎯

Example prompt:
"Every weekday, find the 3 most important news stories about [my industry] from the last 24 hours. Give me a 5-bullet summary with a source link for each."

📌 Available on Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans. It's a research preview, and each run uses your plan's usage.

Why it matters:
The best automation is the one you set up once and forget. 💡

What would you want waiting for you every morning? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.
